summary: Meta Platforms filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $9.0 billion six-tranche senior unsecured note offering: $1.75B 4.300% due 2031, $1.25B 4.650% due 2033, $1.0B 4.900% due 2035, $1.75B 5.400% due 2038, $1.75B 6.050% due 2044, and $1.5B 6.400% due 2065. Public offering prices were 99.446%-99.988%, gross proceeds $8.9838B and net $8.9643B after $19.5M underwriting discount. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley served as joint book-running managers. Notes settle November 12, 2026 in book-entry form via Clearstream/Euroclear, are unsecured and pari passu, and are callable with tax-redemption provisions; a Nasdaq bond listing is intended. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch rate-spread demand and leverage commentary rather than any event-driven angle.
